pages.text: Create: Enchantment Industry turns experience into a fluid, $(thing)Liquid Experience$(), and automates enchanting, disenchanting, and book copying with Create machines.

pages.title: Experience Hatch
pages.text: Right-click to store your own XP in it; sneak-click to take XP out. A filter slot lets other mods' fluids count as XP.

Other XP sources: a Mechanical Grindstone over a Grindstone Drain crushes Experience Nuggets into liquid. Crushing Wheels and Deployers drop nuggets when they kill mobs. An Experience Lantern collects nearby orbs.

pages.title: Blaze Enchanter
pages.text: Acts as an enchanting table fed with Liquid Experience. Set the enchant level on its panel. A template item limits the result to that item's enchantments.

pages.title: Blaze Forger
pages.text: Acts as an anvil with no repair cost. Merges enchantments, and can apply or extract them using Enchanting Templates.

pages.title: Printer
pages.text: Copies written books and enchanted books, names items, copies train schedules, clipboards and package addresses. Check JEI for recipes.

Super enchanting: feed a Blaze a Cake o' Enchanting and it goes past vanilla level limits, with lightning strikes. Keep a Lightning Rod nearby. The Apotheosis blocks (Affix Augmentor, Gem Cutter, Blaze Composer) need Apotheosis, which is not in this pack.
